rationale: The short thesis is still technically intact — price is below VWAP ($22.29) and the 9-EMA ($22.20) and near session lows — but from $22.13 the distance to the $22.05 take-profit is only ~0.36% while the $22.30 invalidation is ~0.77% away, an unfavorable ~1:2 reward:risk, and recent 1m candles show the down-move stalling into low-volume consolidation. With only $19.62 of the daily loss budget remaining, locking the modest unrealized gain is the better risk-adjusted action than risking most of the remaining buffer on a now-diminished edge.
